architectural_decisions.decision: Six-agent orchestration model: conductor, researcher, doc-writer, style-reviewer, release-notes-formatter, validator
architectural_decisions.rationale: Single responsibility per agent prevents context bleed and enables independent model weight optimization

architectural_decisions.decision: Conductor never writes documentation directly — delegates all writing to doc-writer
architectural_decisions.rationale: Keeps orchestration logic separate from content logic; conductor owns the plan, doc-writer owns the prose

architectural_decisions.decision: Researcher and validator are strictly read-only
architectural_decisions.rationale: Analysis agents should have no write access — this prevents unintended content changes during review passes

style_decisions.decision: Active voice, plain language, front-loaded structure
Max heading depth: H2 → H3 → H4. Never deeper.
Required frontmatter on all docs: title, description, last_updated, doc_type

documentation.note: Use full word in formal contexts; 'docs' acceptable in code/filenames only

user.note: Pick one per document and stay consistent. 'User' is default.
